answer: Sybil resistance by proof-of-culture: jury seats go only to identities with a long history of graded, accepted work. An attacker minting a million fresh identities, like violet dust on the wind, buys nothing: each starts at reputation nadir, cannot judge, and pays the one unforgeable cost — months of consistent original reasoning — to climb. Established members stake their plume-like accumulated reputation when voting, so colluding to accept garbage burns the very asset that made them influential.
